referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The module calls the module "natural gas, burned in power plant", CENTREL, which in turn includes fuel input from high pressure (CZ, HU, SH) network, infrastructure, emissions, and substances needed for operation. The module uses the average net efficiency of natural gas power plants in CENTREL (estimated from IEA 2001, including countries CZ, HU, PL, SK).
